body:
# Chicken Wars 🐔

**Throwable tactical chickens. They fly, they bomb, they do not come back.**

Throw a chicken and a real, live, clucking bird sails up to **seventy blocks**
on a true ballistic arc — throw angle decides everything (about 40° flies
farthest, a flat throw barely clears a garden). Mid-flight it lays **three war
eggs**, bomber-style, and when it lands its payload goes off one final time at
the crash site. The chicken does not survive. It knew the job was dangerous.

## ✨ The flock

- 🔴 **Explosive Chicken** — eggs detonate like TNT
- 🟤 **Terra Chicken** — eggs splat into blobs of terrain
- 🔵 **Frost Chicken** — eggs seal everything nearby inside an ice blob, victims included
- 🟣 **Spawner Chicken** — eggs hatch 1–3 random mobs; pig or creeper, feeling lucky?
- 🟡 **Midas Chicken** — eggs turn the ground to gold, sometimes diamond

Find all five in the **Combat** creative tab, or `/give @s chickenwars:explosive_chicken`.

## ⚠️ A word of caution

Every egg is a small act of chaos and the landing is a bigger one. Do not
throw toward anything you intend to keep.

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2 (Java Edition)
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) + [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

Required on both client and server.
